name: Gasthaus Wastler
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Wastler by Thiersee**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just steps away from the serene shores of **Thiersee**, **Gasthaus Wastler** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality. Whether you're seeking a cozy retreat after a day of hiking in the **Lechtal Alps** or a warm welcome after skiing in the nearby **Achenkirch** or **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis** resorts, our rustic charm and hearty **Tiroler** cuisine will make you feel right at home.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and dusted with powdered sugar—best enjoyed with a steaming cup of **Tiroler** coffee or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**. For those craving something heartier, savor our slow-cooked **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork) with **Krautsalat** and **Knödel**, or try our fresh **Forelle Müllerin** (pan-fried trout) straight from **Thiersee**.

After dinner, unwind in our cozy **Stube** by the crackling fireplace, where local crafts and traditional **Tiroler** decor set the perfect mood. In summer, our sun-drenched terrace overlooks the lake, offering a peaceful spot to sip a **Radler** (beer-mix) or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** while soaking in the mountain views.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Gasthaus Wastler** is your ideal base for exploring **Tirol**’s natural wonders—from the dramatic **Zillertal** valleys to the charming villages of **Imst** and **Landeck**. Whether you're here for adventure, relaxation, or a taste of **Tirol**’s culinary delights, we’re delighted to welcome you.

**Prost and willkommen!**
